articles.headline: Jokic scores 32 in 3rd triple-double this season as Nuggets roll to 128-109 win over Raptors
articles.description: — Nikola Jokic had 32 points, 11 assists and 10 rebounds for his third triple-double this season to lead the Denver Nuggets over the Toronto Raptors 128-109 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Dosunmu scores 21 and Kuminga sparks late surge in Timberwolves’ 117-107 win over Rockets
articles.description: — Ayo Dosunmu had 21 points and Jonathan Kuminga powered a fourth-quarter run that allowed the Minnesota Timberwolves to pull away for a 117-107 win over the Houston Rockets on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Williamson's 23 points and Bey's clutch scoring lift the Pelicans past the Jazz, 120-113 in overtime
articles.description: — Saddiq Bey closed out a 22-point performance with six straight points in the final minutes of overtime, and the New Orleans Pelicans rallied to defeat the Utah Jazz 120-113 on Wednesday night.
